remarks: Lawn maintenance & electric car charger included! Young Colonial w/flexible floorplan designed to comfortably accommodate your lifestyle nestled w/in one of the most desirable non-through Mid-Ridges neighborhoods. Sun-filled kitchen overlooking backyard is heart of home w/granite, stainless steel, ample cabinetry & large eat-in area w/French doors to expansive deck & backyard - ideal for gatherings big & small! Kitchen flows into sitting/dining area w/dbl windows overlooking front yard. Spacious family room also bathed in natural light. Adjacent dining room (or 4th BR/office) enclosed w/pocket French doors has easy access to FBA w/stall shower. Grand MBR has walk-in + linen closet & FBA w/dbl sinks, jetted tub & sep shower. 2 more BRs, FBA w/dbl-sinks & W/D. Finished LL has exceptional multi-purpose area & impressive storage. Other highlights: hardwood floors, recessed lights, ceiling fans, C/A, city water/sewer & smart thermostats. Outside offers a perfect amount of greenspace for entertaining & play. Prime street w/privacy & space (each home sited on generously-proportioned lots) w/the security, comfort & convenience of having each neighbor safely in sight, yet in an incredibly central, walkable location: High Ridge/Bulls Head retail corridors, along w/parks, schools, library & houses of worship are w/in a 1/2mi to 1 1/2mi, incl. Trader Joe's, Whole Foods & 2 Starbucks among many other stores, restaurants & more. Settle into a home that offers the best of all worlds today!
